# Afaao

> Afaao is a Toronto based revenue operations consultancy that works remotely with growing B2B teams worldwide. We set up, fix and connect the revenue stack across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops and Customer Success Ops, without the cost of full time ops hires.

Core platforms: Salesforce, HubSpot and Gainsight. We also work across Marketo, Pardot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, ChurnZero, Totango, Vitally, Zendesk, Intercom, ZoomInfo, Cognism, Clay, Apollo.io, 6sense, LeanData, Chili Piper, Calendly, Outreach, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Zapier, Make, Workato, Segment, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Tableau.

## Services
- [Salesforce Consultant in Toronto for B2B Teams](https://afaao.com/salesforce-consulting/): Toronto based Salesforce consulting for B2B teams worldwide. Org cleanup, Flow automation, lead routing, Pardot and HubSpot sync, reporting and admin help.
- [HubSpot Consultant in Toronto for B2B Teams](https://afaao.com/hubspot-consulting/): Toronto based HubSpot consulting for B2B teams worldwide. Lifecycle stages, workflows, lead routing, integrations, cleanup and reporting.
- [Gainsight Consultant and Admin Support for CS Teams](https://afaao.com/gainsight-consulting/): Gainsight consultant and part time admin for growing CS teams. Health scores, CTAs, playbooks, CRM sync and admin support, remote from Toronto.

## Insights
- [Why your HubSpot leads go unassigned, and how to fix lead routing](https://afaao.com/insights/hubspot-leads-unassigned/): New leads sitting in HubSpot with no owner? The usual reasons lead routing breaks, and how to fix triggers, rotation rules and fallbacks.
- [How to fix HubSpot and Salesforce integration and sync issues](https://afaao.com/insights/hubspot-salesforce-sync-errors/): Picklists, validation rules, duplicates and permissions. A plain guide to the most common HubSpot and Salesforce sync errors and how to fix them.
- [How to build a Gainsight health score your CS team actually trusts](https://afaao.com/insights/gainsight-health-score-setup/): A practical guide to Gainsight scorecards: picking measures, weighting, CSM sentiment and checking the score against real churn so your team trusts it.
- [Do you need a full time Gainsight admin? Your options for a growing CS team](https://afaao.com/insights/gainsight-admin-options/): Hiring a full time Gainsight admin, sharing the job with ops, or using a part time partner. What each option costs you, and how to pick the right one.
- [How to fix a messy HubSpot portal or a failed HubSpot implementation](https://afaao.com/insights/fix-messy-hubspot-portal/): HubSpot set up in a rush and now nobody trusts it? A step by step way to rescue a failed HubSpot implementation without starting from scratch.
- [How to build a customer health score in HubSpot](https://afaao.com/insights/hubspot-customer-health-score/): A practical way to build a customer health score in HubSpot: what to measure, where the data lives, and how to make CSMs act on it.
- [Should you hire a RevOps person or outsource it?](https://afaao.com/insights/hire-revops-or-outsource/): In house RevOps hire, a freelancer, or an outsourced RevOps partner. What each option is good at, where it falls short, and how a small B2B team should choose.
- [Lead to account matching in HubSpot: how it works and how to fix it](https://afaao.com/insights/hubspot-lead-to-account-matching/): How HubSpot matches contacts to companies, why leads end up on the wrong account or none at all, and practical ways to fix lead to account matching.
- [Pipedrive to HubSpot migration: a practical checklist](https://afaao.com/insights/pipedrive-to-hubspot-migration/): A step by step checklist for moving from Pipedrive to HubSpot without losing history: cleanup, field mapping, import order, original create dates and testing.
